Tofu Miso Poke.note: Tofu, edamame; miso = soy + gluten (v4 rule); toasted sesame. Vegan.

Quinoa Power Bowl.note: Tahini = sesame. Pumpkin seeds are not tree nuts. Vegan.

Soba Noodle Bowl.note: Soba with wheat; edamame and sesame-soy dressing.

Nasi Ulam Bowl.note: Salted fish = fish; sambal belacan = crustaceans; kerisik is coconut (not tree nut). Mildly spicy.

Tuna Mayo Wrap.note: Wheat tortilla; tuna; mayonnaise = egg; cheddar.

Roasted Pumpkin Feta Salad.note: Feta; pecans; balsamic stated with sulphites.

Mushroom Miso Soup.note: Miso = soy + gluten; tofu; bonito dashi = fish, so not vegetarian (hidden).

Iced Matcha Oat Latte.note: Oat milk = oats = gluten (EU cereal rule). Dairy-free.

Fresh Coconut Water.note: Coconut is not a tree nut.

Peanut Butter Protein Balls.note: Peanut butter; oats = gluten. Pea protein, coconut. Vegan.

Almond Matcha Bliss Balls.note: Almonds and cashews; honey, so not vegan. Stated gluten-free.

Acai Bowl.note: Granola oats = gluten; honey, so not vegan.
